I don't know. The retrieved documents don't say which pgvector version lets pg_upgrade carry HNSW indexes across a major PostgreSQL upgrade without rebuilding them.

The closest material doesn't answer it:

- The changelog's 0.6.0 entry only says "If upgrading with Postgres 12 or Docker, see [these notes](https://github.com/pgvector/pgvector#060)." [pgvector/CHANGELOG.md]. It doesn't mention pg_upgrade or index rebuilds.
- The Upgrading section covers updating the extension within a database: "ALTER EXTENSION vector UPDATE;" [pgvector/README.md]. It says nothing about major PostgreSQL version upgrades.

The README's 0.6.0 notes or the full changelog might cover this, but they aren't in the retrieved context.
